item.title: Pigeonhole 1.7.3
item.description: • Fixes tab groups disappearing from saved spaces. When the extension reloaded (it does on every update) while a space's tabs were waiting after a Quick switch, Pigeonhole could save that space without its groups. Groups now survive reloads and updates. If a space lost its groups, open it in Pigeonhole's page, choose History, pick a snapshot from before, and click Restore all.
